name: Omat Advanced Materials (Guangdong) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Omat Advanced Materials (Guangdong) Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of high-performance sputtering targets. The company provides target materials, metal materials and machined parts, residual target, processing services, and others. It also offers copper, aluminum, molybdenum and molybdenum alloy, TCOM and ITO targets, and copper grid line special targets. In addition, the company is involved in high-performance metals, and key materials and components in cutting-edge technology fields. It serves semiconductor displays, integrated circuits, HJT solar cells, solar cells, new energy batteries, touch screens, architectural glass, and decorative coatings, …
